name: Effect: Curse of Potent Poison

source.title: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind

text:
This curse magically speeds poison through your body.

---

Effect You take a -1 status penalty to Fortitude saves and you gain weakness 3 to poison (if you already have weakness to poison, increase it by 3). The curse remains until removed by Cleanse Affliction or similar magic.
